_comment: T-473 Vault of the First Hollowing raid boss 2 — the Dirgemother (interrupt/throughput check, 10-man). Instance-scoped via data/instances/hollow_vault.json. Reuses the restless-shade silhouette at 1.4; mob_id 'mob_vault_dirgemother' is the unique kill-credit / T-473 weekly loot alias. T-332 'dirge' chassis re-statted for 10: HP (50+150*5)*34 = 27,200 -> ~93s at RAID_DPS 293. The dirge pulses 6/tick room-wide and cancels at 600 damage dealt mid-channel: a raid (293 dps) silences it in ~2.0s (~40 pulses, 240 raid-wide); a 5-party (165 dps) eats ~3.6s (~430 each) per channel on top of 20*3.0/2.2s = 27 dps tank melee — the healing-throughput wall. Uninterrupted (160 ticks = 8s) it lands 960 and wipes the room.
name: The Dirgemother
